<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}

>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Accepts an `AuthnRequest` DEFLATE-compressed and base64-encoded in the
`SAMLRequest` parameter, per the HTTP-Redirect binding.

**The inflated document is bounded, not just the query string.** DEFLATE
compresses a megabyte of repetition into a few kilobytes, so a request
small enough to accept can expand into one that is not — the
decompression-bomb shape this binding invites.

With a live session that satisfies any `RequestedAuthnContext`, the
assertion is issued immediately; otherwise the browser is sent to the
hosted login and returns here. The answer is delivered as a
self-submitting form POSTing to the service provider's **registered**
Assertion Consumer Service URL — never one the request named.
